parameters.query:
SELECT c.ml_user_id, c.access_token, c.status, c.bridge_enabled,
       (SELECT a.custom_attributes->'mercadolibre'->'user'->>'site_id' FROM accounts a WHERE a.id = c.account_id) AS site_id,
       (SELECT a.custom_attributes->>'receive_only' FROM accounts a WHERE a.id = c.account_id) AS receive_only
FROM meli_credentials c
WHERE c.account_id = '{{ $('filter_and_extract').item.json.account_id }}'
ORDER BY c.id ASC
LIMIT 1;
